features.name: Admin MCP Server for Business Central
features.description: A remote MCP server that exposes Business Central Admin API functionality to AI agents and clients. It is stateless, uses HTTP protocol, and leverages Entra ID with OAuth 2.1 for authentication. The server is similar in design to the existing Admin Center API.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is a public preview and um we are hoping to open up more more APIs and more scenarios going forward
caveats: Certain destructive operations are not exposed for security reasons
Cannot uninstall applications or delete environments via MCP
Cannot set or clear security groups
Cannot rename environments or link/unlink Power Platform
Limited to SaaS, not on-premises
Does not support publishing extensions
May reconsider adding excluded APIs in future

features.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Fundamentals
features.description: MCP is described as a USB-C protocol for providing tools and resources to AI agents. Created by Anthropic and adopted by major companies, it wraps APIs in JSON RPC with natural language descriptions. It is transport-agnostic and can use HTTP, stdio, or other connections.

features.name: OAuth 2.1 Authentication for Admin MCP
features.description: Admin MCP uses Entra ID with OAuth 2.1 protocol, which is OAuth 2.0 with less secure flows removed and some flows hardened. The well-known discovery endpoint enables seamless client setup and connection.

features.name: Multi-Tenant Administration via MCP
features.description: MCP enables partner-supported multi-tenant administration scenarios with sample implementations provided in the BC Tech open-source repository on GitHub.
caveats: Only samples provided; not a complete turnkey solution
Requires understanding of code and adaptation to specific needs

features.name: Admin MCP Setup in Visual Studio Code
features.description: Single-tenant scenario demonstrating seamless MCP server configuration in VS Code settings. Includes discovery of 42 available tools and natural language agent interaction to query environments, quotas, and database usage.
caveats: Demonstration environment with sample data

features.name: MCP Agent-Assisted Environment Diagnostics
features.description: AI agent can automatically discover and investigate failed upgrades, identify problematic extensions, determine root causes in code, and propose remediation steps by analyzing operations and code repositories.
caveats: Agent investigation depends on access to source code and error details
Agent cannot directly uninstall applications for security reasons

features.name: Agent-driven environment uninstall and upgrade
features.description: The admin MCP agent can uninstall extensions and schedule environment upgrades using natural language commands. The agent verifies uninstallation before triggering upgrades.
features.status_evidence_quote: This is a security measure for our public preview.
caveats: Agent cannot uninstall extensions by design
Uninstallation must be manual or scheduled

features.name: Admin MCP Server authentication flow
features.description: Admin MCP server exposes tools and a well-known authentication endpoint. VS Code and Copilot Studio authenticate via Entra to obtain tokens and cache credentials for subsequent API calls.
features.status_evidence_quote: This is a security measure for our public preview.

features.name: Copilot Studio MCP custom connector setup
features.description: Users can create custom MCP connectors in Copilot Studio by registering an Entra application, specifying OAuth 2.0 endpoints, client credentials, and scopes. The connector supports JSON RPC calls to the Admin MCP server.
features.status_evidence_quote: This is a security measure for our public preview.
caveats: Requires Entra application registration
Requires manual configuration of redirect URI

features.name: Agent tool invocation via MCP
features.description: Agents in Copilot Studio can invoke tools from the Admin MCP server using JSON RPC protocol. Agents can query available tools and execute operations like listing Business Central environments.
features.status_evidence_quote: This is a security measure for our public preview.

features.name: Admin MCP server connection
features.description: Ability to create and verify connections to the admin MCP server using JSON RPC protocol and list available tools.

features.name: Agent integration with MCP tools in Propeller Studio
features.description: Agents in Propeller Studio can call MCP tools to list Business Central environments and manage delegated flows authentication.
caveats: Only delegated flows supported, no S2S
Requires interactive user sign-in

features.name: MCP proxy for multi-tenant partner scenarios
features.description: A thin wrapper around admin MCP that enables partners to manage multiple customer tenants through a single proxy, adding tenant ID parameter and tenant-specific authentication tools.
caveats: Available as sample code in BC Tech repository
Requires local or cloud deployment
Requires S2S authentication requires additional configuration if applications already exist in customer tenants

features.name: Encrypted authentication data persistence
features.description: MCP proxy saves authentication data in encrypted form locally on the machine to avoid repeated authentication per tenant.

features.name: GitHub Copilot CLI with MCP
features.description: GitHub Copilot CLI can be configured with MCP tools to execute administrative queries across multiple tenants using the proxy setup.

features.name: S2S authentication option for MCP proxy
features.description: MCP proxy sample code can be modified to use S2S token flows instead of delegated flows for application-based authentication.
caveats: Requires modification of sample code
Requires application setup

features.name: Admin MCP samples in BC Tech GitHub repository
features.description: Sample code and partners implementation guidance for admin MCP available in the BC Tech repository on GitHub.

features.name: Extension uninstall limitation
features.description: The admin MCP deliberately does not expose extension uninstall functionality as a destructive API for safety reasons.
caveats: May be reconsidered for future releases

features.name: Publish extension API limitation
features.description: Publishing extensions is not currently part of the admin API, but the team is working to add this capability in the future.
features.status_evidence_quote: we would like to add it to admin API. So, it most likely will appear in in the future.
caveats: No specific timeline provided
